xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-4476: Shared Sessions v0 (slice 5): prompt drafts, contributor direct-submit and FIFO queue

plan.title: Shared Sessions v0 (slice 5): prompt drafts, contributor direct-submit and FIFO queue
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

narratives.Problem: After slice 4 a shared-conversation viewer can only watch. The drafts channel carries nothing, the host hub reads only the hello on control, the viewer drops SharedMessage.author, and the contributor grant set by the slice-2 lobby has no effect. The parent PRD requires live prompt suggestions (FR-7), contributor direct-submit (FR-8) and a strict-FIFO host queue that flushes at turn end with an 'agent is working / N queued' indicator (FR-14).
narratives.Proposal: Per .pan/drafts/PAN-4476.md: additive wire types (submit, submit-ack, draft-sent, DraftUpdate, stream agentWorking/queued, ShareView drafts/queue); a host DraftBoard (per-author LWW, host-set identity, 200 ms relay, backfill, no echo) and a SubmitQueue (strict FIFO, one delivery per agent turn through the handleConversationMessage door with the scheduled-messages outcome rule, '/', '!' and '#' prefixes refused); PeerHub wiring with a contributor gate and grant-revoke drops; author attribution by text correlation in the conversation bridge; POST /api/shares/:code/prompts for controller sends; a SuggestionList used read-only on the viewer page and with pick/edit/send in the host share dialog; a viewer draft box with contributor Send and the queue line; dev and user docs.
narratives.NonGoals:
- No CRDT or collaborative co-editing of one draft (a future collab channel).
- No controller handoff and no viewer acting as controller (slice 7, PAN-4478); only the host picks and sends drafts.
- No terminal channel content (slice 6, PAN-4477); terminal keeps no inbound handler.
- No persistence of drafts or the queue across host restarts and no host reconnect (slice 8, PAN-4479).
- No reordering, editing or cancelling of queued prompts.
- The host's own normal composer sends are not queued.
- No contributor attribution in the host's own conversation timeline.
- No attachments or images in shared prompts; no slash commands, '!' shell commands or '#' memory notes from shared prompts.
- No resuming of an ended conversation before delivery.
- No auto-contributor designation by GitHub handle and no hosted web join (PAN-4481).
- No turn detection for non-Claude harnesses beyond the 30 s fallback.
- No suggestion list on the host conversation page outside the share dialog.
- No logging of draft or prompt text.

metadata.sizeJustification: About 38 files across about 7 path-subsystems because the lint counts each top-level doc file (anywhere.mdx, configuration/shared-sessions.mdx, docs/SHARED-SESSIONS.md), scripts/frontend-test-subset.txt and tests/unit separately, and every module ships with its own test file. The code is one vertical feature that the issue scopes as slice 5: drafts are useless without the suggestion list, a contributor submit is unsafe without the host queue and its gate, and the controller send shares that queue. Slices 2-4 shipped with the same justification. 16 items keep each diff reviewable.

autoDecisions.summary: Controller sends go through the same host FIFO queue via POST /api/shares/:code/prompts (D-1).
autoDecisions.rationale: One ordering and one 'N queued' count for every shared prompt, plus attribution for picked drafts; the host's normal composer stays unqueued.

autoDecisions.summary: SuggestionList for the controller mounts in the existing ShareDialog, fed by the 1 s GET /api/shares poll (D-2).
autoDecisions.rationale: Reuses slice-2 D-6 polling; no new push channel to the host browser; about one second of latency is acceptable for suggestions.

autoDecisions.summary: Queue status (agentWorking, queued) rides optional fields on presence SharedStream (D-3).
autoDecisions.rationale: Per-stream status fits the parent PRD's multi-stream forward-compatibility rule, and presence is already re-sent only on change.

autoDecisions.summary: Viewer -> host drafts use a new DraftUpdate {text}; the host sets author fields itself and never echoes a draft to its author (D-4, D-5).
autoDecisions.rationale: The viewer page does not reliably know its GitHub id, the host must not trust inbound identity, and echoes would overwrite live typing.

autoDecisions.summary: Turn detection polls summarizeConversationActivity every 1 s; after each delivery the queue waits for the turn to start (working, a new last message, or 30 s) and then to end (D-6, D-7).
autoDecisions.rationale: The activity summary is mtime-cached and its 180 s staleness guard prevents a wedged queue; the start wait prevents two prompts in one turn.

autoDecisions.summary: Delivery reuses the scheduled-messages door rule: 2xx sent, 409 retry, other 4xx refused, 5xx/throw unknown and never redelivered (D-8).
autoDecisions.rationale: Proven at-most-once semantics already in the codebase (scheduled-message-delivery.ts).

autoDecisions.summary: Shared prompts starting with '/', '!' or '#' are refused for contributors and controller sends alike (D-9).
autoDecisions.rationale: handleConversationMessage routes '/pan' commands and '/compact', and the Claude Code TUI runs '!' as a shell command; a remote person must never reach them.

autoDecisions.summary: Author attribution is text correlation in the conversation bridge, not a prompt prefix (D-10).
autoDecisions.rationale: SharedMessage.author was reserved for this slice; a prefix would change what the agent reads; a mismatch just leaves the author unset.

autoDecisions.summary: Limits: 8,000 characters per draft/prompt, 20 queued total, 3 per contributor, 200 ms host relay throttle, 150 ms viewer send throttle, 64 KiB inbound envelope cap (D-11).
autoDecisions.rationale: Bounds keystroke fan-out and per-viewer memory on the host without affecting normal prompt sizes.

autoDecisions.summary: ShareView.drafts and ShareView.queue are optional in the type (D-13).
autoDecisions.rationale: Existing slice-2 fixtures and tests keep compiling; viewOf always sets both.

autoDecisions.summary: Drafts and the queue are memory only and drop on host restart or share end (D-15).
autoDecisions.rationale: Host reconnect is slice 8; persisting prompts adds a state store the repo avoids.

autoDecisions.summary: The plan keeps all four issue bullets plus attribution in one slice with a sizeJustification instead of splitting into new sibling issues.
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue body scopes slice 5 as one unit; slices 2-4 used the same justification and finalize accepted it.

autoDecisions.summary: The Playwright spec is not added to test:playwright.
autoDecisions.rationale: Follows the slice-2 and slice-4 D-20 precedent: it needs two built dashboards and Chromium; unit and loopback tests are the CI coverage.

Create the strict-FIFO SubmitQueue that delivers one shared prompt per agent turn

metadata.parallelSafeReason: New module plus its own test file; no other item edits them, and its inputs are only the contracts types and helpers from its blockers.

narrative.Action: Follow PRD .pan/drafts/PAN-4476.md WI-4, decisions D-6..D-9, D-11 and section 'Submit queue'. Create src/dashboard/server/sharing/submit-queue.ts exporting QUEUE_TICK_MS = 1_000, TURN_START_TIMEOUT_MS = 30_000, QUEUE_MAX_ITEMS = 20, QUEUE_MAX_PER_AUTHOR = 3, class SubmitQueue(deps { deliver, activity, now }, events { onDelivering, onOutcome, onStatus }) with enqueue, dropAuthor, setWatching, view, close, and productionSubmitQueueDeps(conversationName) using decodeDoorResponse + handleConversationMessage (as scheduled-message-delivery.ts lines 79-84) and resolveClaudeSessionFile + summarizeConversationActivity. State machine idle -> awaiting-start (ends on working true, a changed lastMessageId, or 30 s) -> awaiting-end (ends on working false). Door rule: 2xx sent; 409 keep head and retry next tick; other 4xx delivery_refused; >=500 or throw delivery_unknown, never redelivered. Ticker is a re-armed setTimeout, one tick at a time, stopped when empty, idle and not watching. enqueue checks sharedPromptRefusal, then queue_full limits. No logging of prompt text; no execSync. Tests in src/dashboard/server/sharing/__tests__/submit-queue.test.ts with vi.useFakeTimers() covering cases (a)-(l) of WI-4.

items.title: Given submits A, B and C enqueued in one tick while activity reports working, when fake timers advance through three turns, then deliver is called in the order A, B, C and never twice without an intervening working-true then working-false turn

Given a 2xx delivery while working stays false and lastMessageId is unchanged, when timers advance, then the next item is delivered only after TURN_START_TIMEOUT_MS plus an idle tick, and a changed lastMessageId ends that wait earlier

A 409 answer keeps the item at the head and redelivers it on the next idle tick; a 400 emits onOutcome delivery_refused; a 500 or a thrown deliver emits delivery_unknown and the item is never delivered again
enqueue rejects '/pan status' as invalid_prompt, the 21st item and a 4th queued contributor item from one author as queue_full, and still accepts a controller item while that author is at 3
When the queue is empty, idle and not watching, vi.getTimerCount() returns 0, and after close() no event callback fires

When the spec runs, then it saves viewer-composer-light.png, viewer-composer-dark.png, host-suggestions-light.png and host-suggestions-dark.png under test-results/pan-4476/
Document drafts, contributor prompts and the queue in the dev and user docs

verify_commands: grep -c 'Prompt drafts, contributor submits and the queue (slice 5, PAN-4476)' docs/SHARED-SESSIONS.md
! grep -q 'extra powers in a later release' configuration/shared-sessions.mdx
expected_outputs: the negated grep exits 0 because the old sentence is gone

narrative.Action: Follow PRD .pan/drafts/PAN-4476.md WI-16 exactly. docs/SHARED-SESSIONS.md: update the drafts and control rows of the slice-3 channel table (lines 199-203) and add the section '## Prompt drafts, contributor submits and the queue (slice 5, PAN-4476)' before '## Local development' with every listed topic. configuration/shared-sessions.mdx: replace the 'extra powers in a later release' and 'sees the same thing as any other viewer' text, add the Grant/Remove contributor item, the '## Suggestions and contributor prompts' section with the trust warning, the Roles and What viewers see and Limits additions, and change line 77 to 'Handing control to another person comes in a later release.'. anywhere.mdx line 270: replace 'prompt suggestions and contributor prompts are still planned' with 'viewers can suggest prompts, and contributors can send them'. Run npm run lint:docs.

items.title: docs/SHARED-SESSIONS.md contains the slice-5 section that names QUEUE_TICK_MS, TURN_START_TIMEOUT_MS, the refused '/', '!' and '#' prefixes and POST /api/shares/:code/prompts with its status codes

configuration/shared-sessions.mdx no longer contains 'extra powers in a later release' or 'sees the same thing as any other viewer', and contains a 'Suggestions and contributor prompts' section that warns to make only trusted people contributors
